9.9.5. qnav.quantum.gravity_gradient

9.9.5.1. gravity_gradient.py

summary:

Provides implementation for Quantum gravity gradient sensing and fusion. Implementation is mainly based on Peters et al, ‘High precision gravity measurements using atom interferometry’, Metrologia, Vol.38, pp.25-61 (2001).

authors:
Prof. Jason Ralph - jfralph@liverpool.ac.uk
Michael Wright - mjwright@liverpool.ac.uk
version:

1.0.0 - First full implementation of class.

class qnav.quantum.gravity_gradient.GravityGradInterferometer(num_of_atoms: int = 200000, atom_mass: float = 1.4431608262e-25, recoil_velocity: float = 0.0058845, stationary_velocity: float = 1.57, sensor_z_top: float = 0.0, sensor_z_bottom: float = -1.0, eta: float = 0.25, time_pulse: float = 0.2, sigma_phi: float = 0.025, sigma_n: float = 1.0, beam_width: float = 0.01, sensor_length: float = 1.5, rand_failure_prob: float = 0.0)[source]

Parameters used by the Cold Atom Gravity Gradient Interferometer. These properties describe the qualities of an ultra-cold atom interferometer, which is used for capturing gravity gradient estimations from the local environment.

property k_eff: float

Effective wave number, the number of wave cycles per unit distance. A property provided for a value commonly calculated.

Returns:

A measure of the spatial frequency of a wave.

Return type:

float

class qnav.quantum.gravity_gradient.GravityGradiometer(full_frequency: float, imu_frequency: float, accelerometer_errors: ~qnav.measurement.error_properties.ErrorProperties, interferometer: ~qnav.quantum.gravity_gradient.GravityGradInterferometer, gravity_model: ~qnav.gravity.base.GravityModel, sensor_axis: ~qnav.measurement.platform.SensorAxis = <qnav.measurement.platform.SensorAxis object>, duty_cycle: float = 0.5, start_time: float = 0.0, rand_seed: int = None)[source]

Quantum Gravity Gradiometer Sensor for estimating vertical gravity gradient. A Quantum sensor that features two ultra-cold atom accelerometers, measuring the change in the vertical gravity gradient.

take_measurement(est_time: float, ground_truth: GroundTruth)[source]

Samples from the ground truth to collect data to produce measurements. Using the current ground truth, captures the

Parameters:

  • est_time (float) – The estimated time the measurement of the sensor is expected to be captured at (in seconds).

  • ground_truth (GroundTruth) – The corresponding ground truth data.

reset()[source]

Resets the sensor, clearing all previous measurements. Normally used directly after fusion.

update(time_sec: float = None)[source]

Called on demand to update the sensor’s state. Typically called after measurements have been taken. When called this increases the next measurement time and propagates internal states, to the time difference.

Parameters:

time_sec (float) – The current simulation time in seconds.

property last_measurement: tuple[float, float]

Returns the latest measurement produced from the sensor.

Returns:

Return type:

tuple[float, float]

Returns:

The number of internal measurement steps used.

int

class qnav.quantum.gravity_gradient.ParticleFilterParams(num_particles: int = 1000, init_position_sigma: float = 20.0, init_velocity_sigma: float = 1e-05, init_attitude_sigma: float = 1e-05, weight_sigma: float = 0.00126, alpha: float = 0.05, beta: float = 0.05, gamma: float = 0.05, position_sigma: float = 2.0, velocity_sigma: float = 0.005, attitude_sigma: float = 0.001, ellipse_intervals: int = 361, ellipse_iterations: int = 5)[source]

Particle Filter Properties for the gravity gradient fusion methods. A list of properties relating to the particle filter processing.

class qnav.quantum.gravity_gradient.GravityGradientPF(qs_gravity_grad: GravityGradiometer, filter_params: ParticleFilterParams = ParticleFilterParams(num_particles=1000, init_position_sigma=20.0, init_velocity_sigma=1e-05, init_attitude_sigma=1e-05, weight_sigma=0.00126, alpha=0.05, beta=0.05, gamma=0.05, position_sigma=2.0, velocity_sigma=0.005, attitude_sigma=0.001, ellipse_intervals=361, ellipse_iterations=5), est_interferometer: GravityGradInterferometer = None, rng_seed: int = None)[source]

Gravity Gradient Particle Filter Fusion. Applies position correction using gravity gradient signals, via a particle filter approach.

perform_fusion(estimated_state: EstimatedState) → None[source]

Performs the fusion with sensors and updates the estimated state. When called performs fusion when gravity gradient sensor measurements are ready. When so, the particle filter algorithms is employed and the estimated state is updated.

Parameters:

estimated_state (EstimatedState) – The current estimated states of the platform. This is what the fusion method will update.

init_particle_filter(estimated_state: EstimatedState) → None[source]

Initialises the particle filter using current estimate. This is called during the first iteration, setting the particles’ estimated position, velocity and attitude values based around the current estimated state. The range of estimation is based on the initial sigma values set in the filter properties for each.

Parameters:

estimated_state (EstimatedState) – The current estimated states of the platform.

reset()[source]

Resets the state of the fusion, clearing internal temporary states. When call the fusion will return to expecting the first measurement, then continuing from there.
